executive_summary: Maven build failed with 43 compilation errors due to missing dependencies. The primary root cause is missing Spring Security, Spring Data JPA, Jakarta Persistence, and Apache Commons Lang3 dependencies in pom.xml. All errors are dependency-related and can be resolved by adding the required dependencies to the project configuration.

errors.root_cause: Spring Security dependency is missing from pom.xml. Multiple security-related packages cannot be resolved including HttpSecurity, SecurityFilterChain, and EnableWebSecurity.

Spring Data JPA dependency is missing from pom.xml. Multiple repository interfaces (JpaRepository, Modifying, Query, Param) and domain classes (Page, Pageable) cannot be resolved across ColumnRepository, TaskRepository, and UserRepository.
Jakarta Persistence API is missing. JPA annotations (@Entity, @Table, @Id, @Column, @ManyToOne, @JoinColumn) cannot be resolved in entity classes.
errors.fix_recommendation: Jakarta Persistence is typically included with spring-boot-starter-data-jpa. Ensure spring-boot-starter-data-jpa dependency is added to pom.xml.

errors.root_cause: Apache Commons Lang3 library is missing from pom.xml. StringUtils class cannot be resolved.
